evals.prompt: I need ground tiles for my tower defense: grass, dirt path, and the edges where they meet. 64px, top-down, same look as the attached worker sprite.
evals.expected_output: Tile size 64 / top-down / light top-left stated; grass and dirt base tiles seamless via wrap duplication, 2–3 variants each; 16-tile (4-bit) edge set built from three masters with rotations; tile_check seam/set/atlas run and passing; atlas.json delivered; ground contrast kept below the sprite's.

evals.prompt: My grass tile shows a line every 64 pixels in Godot. Here it is (attached).
evals.expected_output: Runs tile_check seam first, reports which edge and the seam/interior ratio, finds the shape cut at the edge, adds the wrapped <use> copy, re-checks, mentions texture filter / bleed if the seam is only visible when zoomed.

evals.prompt: Make a cliff tileset for an RPG.
evals.expected_output: Chooses 3/4 view and the 47-tile blob layout (inner corners needed), draws edge / outer corner / inner corner / interior masters, derives the rest by rotation, names files b00–b46, packs with --cols 8, explains Godot terrain set mode Match Corners and Sides.

evals.prompt: Draw a big boulder for the map.
evals.expected_output: Recognises a single placed object, not a tile; routes to svg-character-design (objects.md) or asks whether it should be a tile decal.
